verdict: PASS as full-lookup word-operation transport with explicit reference boundary
review_mode: Independent exact source/transitive definitions and unchanged cached reference-body review; no builds/downloads/edits
findings: referenceEntry explicitly skips the entire operation at zero value, matching the value guard in source process_call. This avoids fabricating missing accounts through a zero-valued ProtocolTransfer.debit/credit; the zero branch proves actual pinned entry has identical lookups by reinsertion of unchanged accounts.

Positive funded value derives an actual sender account. Alias case credits then debits versus debits then credits the same account and uses proved modular add/sub cancellation, preserving every other field. Distinct-address cases explicitly split recipient present/absent and compare complete Account option lookups at all addresses.

entry_lookup proves full pointwise account equality, including existence and every account field, not merely balances or code/storage projections. No finite-world wealth ceiling is required for this word-operation equality; funding remains necessary to exclude the unfunded positive missing-sender case.

checked derives recipient-after-debit balance+amount<=original worldFunds via actual debit_funds and balance_le_funds, then applies the explicit total<UInt256.size. Source subtraction is guarded by the given funded condition. Aliases and absence require no convenience exclusion or recipient no-wrap premise.

from_ledger obtains the actual worldFunds bound from ledger_bound funding trace and LedgerCreditSafety.genesis_budget on that same c.world and Counts. It returns derived recipient checked-add plus all lookup equalities without supplying maximum recipient balance.

Cached EL0cc state_tracker.py590-621 uses modify_state(sender) with checked balance subtraction followed by modify_state(recipient) with addition; recipient is therefore read from updated state. Interpreter419-436 executes this only under should_transfer_value and nonzero value, then adds its separate synthetic log for nonalias transfers.
assumptions_and_limits: This covers the source branch in which value transfer is enabled. The source should_transfer_value Boolean and apparent/transferred-value context mapping are not parameters of referenceEntry and must be bound by the outer adapter. No equivalence is implied for nonzero apparent value with transfer disabled, such as delegated execution.

Pointwise Lean AccountMap equality does not establish equality of Python TransactionState diffs, touches, account lifecycle, original-state tracking or checked-U256 library implementation. These are explicitly open representation/source consumers.

Zero-value source skips transfer; checked nevertheless proves an arithmetic guard for the hypothetical debit state, which is harmless but is not a claim that this hypothetical zero-debit insertion actually occurs.
Ledger and Counts still need canonical same-history extraction. This module neither proves protocol admission nor chooses a fork baseline.
Synthetic transfer logs, rollback, gas and code execution remain separate adapters; no full raw-log or evaluator equivalence is asserted.
